table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Code=ExpiryIntimation.IntimationCode,   
	IntimationTypeCode=ExpiryIntimation.IntimationTypeCode,   
	IntimationSerialNo=ExpiryIntimation.IntimationSerialNo,   
	AccCode=ExpiryIntimation.AccCode,   
	AccountName = A.Name, 
	AccountAliasName = A.AliasName,
	Address1 = CS.Address1,
	Address2 = CS.Address2,
	City = CS.City,
	Phone = CS.Phone,
	Fax = CS.Fax,
	Date = ExpiryIntimation.Date,   
	RefNo=ExpiryIntimation.RefNo,   
	Remarks1=ExpiryIntimation.Remarks1,   
	Remarks2=ExpiryIntimation.Remarks2,   
	UserCode=ExpiryIntimation.UserCode,   
	Posted=ExpiryIntimation.Posted,   
	PostedBy=ExpiryIntimation.PostedBy,   
	PostDate=ExpiryIntimation.PostDate,   
	IntimationType=IntimationType.Name,   
	Icode=ExpiryIntimationDetail.ICode,   
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Batch=ExpiryIntimationDetail.Batch,   
	Expiry=ExpiryIntimationDetail.Expiry,   
	Qty=ExpiryIntimationDetail.Qty,   
	PackUnits=ExpiryIntimationDetail.Packunits,   
	PackPrice=ExpiryIntimationDetail.PackPrice,   
	Price=ExpiryIntimationDetail.Price,
	ItemTotal= ExpiryIntimationDetail.Qty * ExpiryIntimationDetail.Price
FROM 
	ExpiryIntimation,   
	ExpiryIntimationDetail,   
	IntimationType,
	Accounts A,
	(SELECT Code=C.CustCode, Address1=C.Address1, Address2=C.Address2, Phone=C.Phone, Fax=C.Fax, City=C.City
	FROM Customer C
	UNION ALL
	SELECT Code=C.SuppCode, Address1=C.Address1, Address2=C.Address2, Phone=C.Phone, Fax=C.Fax, City=C.City
	FROM Supplier C) CS,
	Item I
WHERE 
	ExpiryIntimationDetail.IntimationCode = :ai_code AND
	ExpiryIntimationDetail.IntimationCode = ExpiryIntimation.IntimationCode AND  
	IntimationType.IntimationTypeCode = ExpiryIntimation.IntimationTypeCode AND
	ExpiryIntimation.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.AccCode = CS.Code AND
	ExpiryIntimationDetail.ICode = I.ICode
ORDER BY
	ExpiryIntimationDetail.RowID
